Overview

Heredia is a city in HE with a population of 150,000. The City of Flowers, a charming university town with colonial architecture and coffee estates in the Central Valley. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
